Good food at affordable price
Jan 2020
During our 6 days' stay at Hanoi, we visited here twice.
While hunting for food during Tet Festival, we spotted this restaurant. It was largely because of the 'Tripadvisor' logo, which caught our interest, that we decided to give it a try. We're glad we found it and we're not disappointed. They serve quite large portions with a small bowl of rice at the corner of the plate.
The fried tofu with sweet & sour sauce and vege was good. Grilled pork with lemon grass and chilli was another favourite. Roasted duck in Hanoi was good too.
This place was easy to find. If you walk along the streets near Hoan Kiem Lake, looking for restaurants, you're sure to locate it. Or, try google maps, walking.
